title: Handmade items
description: A datapack that lets you create handmade items! for example a handmade elytra!
body:
A datapack that gives u a reason to play Minecraft more! 






With this datapack u can make a middlegame elytra! it has 70 durability can be repaired with blaze powder and has unbreaking II!


Theres also a handmade mace, it has 15 durability and crafted with an iron block and a blaze rod sounds nice right?
